summary: Temporary danger area EGD196A active near EGLC for drone flights beyond visual line of sight, up to 450 ft, 1 nautical mile radius.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD196A ACTIVATED. AIP SUP 134/2026
REFERS. BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI
THE TDA. EMERG SER AND MIL OPS REQUIRING IMMEDIATE ACCESS TO THE
TDA SHOULD CONTACT HEATHROW RADAR ON FREQ 125.625MHZ. FOR OTHER
CREWED ACFT OR VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT OPS ACCESS, CONTACT THE
OPERATOR 72 HOURS PRIOR TO OPS COMMENCING ON 01332 319137 OR VIA
EMAIL FLIGHTOPS.UK(AT)MATTERNET.COM. AR-2026-4899/45.
